product.title: Guided Point Lobos Nature Walk

description.text: Hike Point Lobos State Natural Reserve on a guided nature walk with a local naturalist. The route covers woodland trails, cliff overlooks, and cove viewpoints while watching for otters, seals, deer, and seabirds in a small-group format.

highlights: Guided hike in Point Lobos State Natural Reserve
Naturalist guide knows wildlife viewing areas
Woodland trails and coastal cliff overlooks

start.description: Meet at the Point Lobos Walks parking area on Highway 1 south of the reserve entrance.

end.description: Return to the Highway 1 meeting parking area after the hike.

product.itinerarySummary: Hike Point Lobos State Natural Reserve on a guided nature walk with a local naturalist.

itineraryItems.title: Point Lobos State Natural Reserve
itineraryItems.description: Enter the reserve for a guided walk through woodland and coastal trails.

itineraryItems.title: Whalers Cove
itineraryItems.description: Stop at cove overlooks to watch for seals and sea otters when visible.

itineraryItems.title: China Cove
itineraryItems.description: View the turquoise cove and cliff formations on the guided route.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking

faqs.question: How long is the Guided Point Lobos Nature Walk?
faqs.answer: The planned duration is 2 hours 30 minutes.

faqs.question: Where does the tour depart from in Monterey?
faqs.answer: Meet at the Point Lobos Walks parking area on Highway 1 south of the reserve entrance.
